templates.title: Free online store templates
templates.description: Free store templates for every category, with a home page, product pages, cart and checkout. Change colors and sections any time without losing your products.

hero.title: Pick a design. Make it yours.

gallery.title: A design made for what you sell
gallery.body: Pick a category and preview a template. Every template can be edited in the builder after you pick it.

included.title: Ready to sell from the first day
included.phoneBody: Every layout starts on the phone, then adapts to larger screens.
included.langBody: Every template works right-to-left and left-to-right.
included.switchBody: Products, orders and settings stay as they are when you change templates.

items.q: Will I lose my products if I change templates?
items.a: No. Products, orders, customers and settings are separate from the design.

items.q: Can I use a template from a different category?
items.a: Yes. Categories are only a starting suggestion. Any template works with any products.

final.body: Claim your store link. You can change the template later.
